ratings.comment: He is very nice, would take him again for any course!

Best Math prof. I've had so far. He's clearly passionate and willing to go in more depth while he explains concepts clearly. He'll also crack a witty joke or statement every know and then, and he might occasionally do something really funny. He always shows up to class with a smile and cares about his students. Lectures are recorded but go to them!

Lectures are not mandatory but are worth attending. You can learn off the textbook but personally I learned better under him and didn't feel the need to use the textbook. He has a good homework system that's not too stressful but enough to where you actually learn, and if you want more there's the practice problems in the textbook. 10/10 instructor
very good, my favorate math professor in this university

Hong might be the best professor I've had so far. He is clearly very passionate about math and gets excited to expand your knowledge about some of the deeper concepts/proofs for certain theorums. Lectures are very helpful and he explains things well.

This guy is legit. He goes over all of the content needed for tests and homework in lecture. Before exams he holds a review during lecture that is actually helpful. Go to lecture, complete the discussion packets and homework and you will succeed in this class. At the end of the day if you're taking 320 pick Hyukpyo as your professor.

Dr. Hong is one of the best math professors at UW. I highly recommend him for Math 320. He has clear motivations for why you're learning what you're learning. He actively seeks feedback and encourages lecture participation. He is willing to set time to help you outside his office hours if needed. Truly an inspirational and caring individual.
